Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1(A.1),(A.2),(A.7) and Appendix A.2. The explicit conditional finite density, Borel subprobability kernel and joint-test construction are attributed ASTIS completion, not a printed standalone theorem. Full ordered-time iteration and(A.7) remain open.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic depth n≥0 let Hist_n=Drecord^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Raw w_n is the next unused threshold. Define the total extended wait W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0, and total real observable t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)); these zero defaults outside positive finite waits are proof observables only. Define the finite nonnegative auxiliary real-time density ρ(live(T,z),s)=λ_r(Φ_s z)exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0))) and ρ(stopped,s)=0, embedded into extended nonnegative reals. W and ρ are jointly Borel and ρ is finite everywhere. For every fixed Borel d:Hist_n→[0,∞), each d(h) finite but not necessarily uniformly bounded, set D_d(h,s)=1_{0<s<d(h)}ρ(h_n,s). The extension ρ at nonpositive s is auxiliary and is killed by this strict guard. D_d is jointly Borel. The actual Mathlib kernel K_d=withDensity(const(Hist_n,real Lebesgue),D_d) satisfies K_d(h)=D_d(h,s)ds for every abstract history h and K_d(h,ℝ)≤1; it is a finite subprobability kernel. This equality explicitly identifies the measurable constructor branch rather than its zero fallback. Let B_d={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))}, X_n(w)=(H_n(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)), and ν_d=D_d(μ_n⊗ds). B_d is Borel, X_n is Borel, (X_n)_*(P restricted to B_d)=ν_d and ν_d(Hist_n×ℝ)≤1. For every jointly Borel F:Hist_n×ℝ→[0,∞], h↦∫_ℝ F(h,s)D_d(h,s)ds is Borel. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B_d∩{H_n∈A}} F(X_n(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫_ℝ F(h,s)D_d(h,s)ds]μ_n(dh). No boundedness or integrability assumption on F, no positive μ_n(A), no normalized conditional probability and no finite-wait/provider hypothesis is needed; extended integrals may be infinite. Stopped histories have zero finite kernel, infinite waits fail the finite guard, and missing mass is not renormalized. The cases d(h)=0, n=0, zero hazards, rank zero and unrealizable abstract histories are included. Real Lebesgue time on the strict Ioo(0,d(h)) is exactly the already verified deterministic Ioc density reference restricted further by Iio(d(h)); no open/closed endpoint-mass equivalence or exact strict mass formula is asserted. All conclusions use the six original standing analytic hypotheses. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one finite jump-density factor implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7). Full ordered-time iteration, final survival/path functional assembly, full(A.7), physical-time residual memorylessness/random restart/Markovness, global nonexplosion/invariance/hypocoercivity, implementation/error/unbounded expected cost/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN. {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
    let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
        (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
    let waitObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
    let timeObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun y xRef q => ((waitObs y xRef q).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
    let density : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (rate xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 a.2) *
            Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)))
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ n : ℕ,
      Measurable (waitObs y xRef) ∧ Measurable (density y xRef) ∧
      (∀ q, density y xRef q ≠ ⊤) ∧
      (∀ d : (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) → ℝ≥0,
        Measurable d →
        let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)
        let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
        let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
        let μ : Measure Hist := Measure.map H P
        let D : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h s =>
          if 0 < s ∧ s < (d h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, s) else 0
        let K : Kernel Hist ℝ := (Kernel.const Hist (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity D
        let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) ∧
          waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) <
            ((d (H w) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
        let X : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist × ℝ := fun w =>
          (H w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n))
        let ν : Measure (Hist × ℝ) := (μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity
          (fun p => D p.1 p.2)
        Measurable (Function.uncurry D) ∧
        (∀ h, K h = (volume : Measure ℝ).withDensity (D h)) ∧
        IsFiniteKernel K ∧ (∀ h, K h Set.univ ≤ 1) ∧
        MeasurableSet B ∧ Measurable X ∧
        Measure.map X (P.restrict B) = ν ∧ ν Set.univ ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ F : Hist × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ s : ℝ, F (h, s) * D h s) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (X w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ s : ℝ, F (h, s) * D h s) ∂μ)))
decoder_context: All displayed functions are literal definitions on a finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. fderiv is Frechet derivative; gradient is the inner-product gradient; ContDiff real2 is twice continuous differentiability.
expMeasure1 is the rate-one exponential law on real numbers; infinitePi is its canonical countable product on real sequences. Real.toNNReal is max(x,0) represented as a nonnegative real.

WithTop NNReal includes infinity. hittingAfter is the infimum of nonnegative times entering the target, infinity if no hit exists. untopD0 returns the finite value, default zero at infinity. Sum.inl/inr are distinct Borel tags; Unit has one element; products associate right.

Fin(n+1) indexes integers0 through n. Measurable is Borel measurability for the indicated product/sum spaces. Measure.map is pushforward. The final integral is a Lebesgue integral of an extended nonnegative function restricted to A, without normalization.

Real division is total, with division by zero equal to zero. Interval integrals are Bochner integrals on real intervals. Nat.rec is the displayed finite recursion. ENNReal.ofReal embeds max(x,0) into extended nonnegative reals.

volume at real time is ordinary Lebesgue measure. A Kernel is a measurable family of measures. Kernel.const uses the same measure at every input. Kernel.withDensity(f) uses the fiber density when uncurry(f) is measurable and otherwise returns the zero kernel. IsFiniteKernel asserts one finite uniform bound on all total fiber masses; it is not a Markov/total-mass-one assertion. Nonnegative extended integrals require no integrability premise.
